title: NotifyConfig
description: Authoring-time configuration. `audience` is REQUIRED and never inferred: the run's acting user is absent for schedule/webhook runs, so inferring it would silently change who is notified based on how the run started.

audience.description: Who sees this. `tenant` = everyone in the workspace. `self` = the run's acting user (REFUSES on a run with no human, e.g. a schedule or webhook). `role:<name>` = holders of that role only (default-deny).

type.description: Notification type key for filtering/preferences. Defaults to `workflow.notice`.
